description: An S-3 operations officer must publish the next-workday roster for four routine support tasks, assigning a support element, setting each task's work window, and recording the control required for each assignment.

shared_context.S1: Four routine support tasks must be scheduled for the next workday: an airfield lighting inspection, a secure radio inventory, a clinic backup-power test, and a warehouse pallet transfer.
shared_context.S2: The available support elements are Airfield Support, Signal Section, Facilities Cell, and Warehouse Cell.
shared_context.S3: Maj. Alvarez publishes the binding daily operations roster, and each task needs one support element, one one-hour work window between 0800 and 1600, and a documented control before it begins.
shared_context.S4: The four tasks are normally coordinated during the daily operations huddle, where the responsible section representatives review the next-workday roster before Maj. Alvarez signs it.

PF1.text: The airfield lighting inspection must use Airfield Support because that is the only element with a current airfield-vehicle qualification, and the inspection must run exactly from 0800 to 0900 before the scheduled airfield access restriction; Capt. Brooks confirmed the qualification roster this morning, but the update is not yet on the operations slide.

PF2.text: The secure radio inventory must use Signal Section and must run exactly from 1300 to 1400 because the encryption-key custodian is available only during that window; Lt. Farah received the custodian's confirmation this morning, but the appointment has not yet been posted to the roster.

PF3.text: The clinic backup-power test must use Facilities Cell and must run exactly from 1100 to 1200, after the clinic's 0900-1100 immunization block; Sgt. Morris confirmed the clinic schedule with the duty nurse today, but the deconfliction is not yet on the daily schedule.

PF4.text: The warehouse pallet transfer must use Warehouse Cell and must run exactly from 1400 to 1500 because the only certified forklift operator and the serviceable 5-ton forklift are available together only in that window; SFC Okafor recorded the equipment status during the morning inventory, but the entry has not yet reached the operations desk.

acceptance_conditions: Airfield Support must conduct the airfield lighting inspection from 0800 to 0900.
Signal Section must conduct the secure radio inventory from 1300 to 1400.
Facilities Cell must conduct the clinic backup-power test from 1100 to 1200.
Warehouse Cell must conduct the warehouse pallet transfer from 1400 to 1500.
The roster must include the airfield access control, encryption-key custodian verification, clinic-service deconfliction, and forklift certification controls.
The secure-radio scheduling fact must be cited in the justification.

content_checks.C9: any(c['target'] == 'Airfield Support' and ('airfield-vehicle qualification' in c['detail'] or 'airfield access' in c['detail'] or 'access restriction' in c['detail'] or 'airfield lighting inspection' in c['detail']) for c in commitments)
content_checks.C10: any(c['target'] == 'Signal Section' and ('encryption-key custodian' in c['detail'] or 'custodian appointment' in c['detail'] or 'custodian availability' in c['detail'] or 'secure radio inventory' in c['detail']) for c in commitments)
content_checks.C11: any(c['target'] == 'Facilities Cell' and ('clinic schedule deconfliction' in c['detail'] or 'immunization block' in c['detail'] or 'clinic deconfliction' in c['detail'] or 'clinic backup-power test' in c['detail']) for c in commitments)
content_checks.C12: any(c['target'] == 'Warehouse Cell' and ('forklift' in c['detail'] or 'certified operator' in c['detail'] or 'serviceable forklift' in c['detail'] or 'equipment status' in c['detail'] or 'warehouse pallet transfer' in c['detail']) for c in commitments)

decisive_facts.why: The current airfield-vehicle qualification changes the airfield inspection assignment to Airfield Support, fixes its window at 0800-0900, and requires the airfield access control.
The encryption-key custodian's availability changes the radio inventory assignment to Signal Section, fixes its window at 1300-1400, and requires custodian verification.
The clinic's 0900-1100 immunization block changes the backup-power test to Facilities Cell from 1100-1200 and requires clinic-service deconfliction.

The combined certified-operator and serviceable-forklift availability changes the pallet-transfer assignment to Warehouse Cell, fixes its window at 1400-1500, and requires a forklift certification check.
